payload.summary: Implemented install rollback and crash journals, owned MCP upgrades, graceful recorder stop/recovery, per-project outbox fault isolation, truthful health, bounded dashboard previews, guarded semantic/scope changes, intent-aware verification, in-flight renewal and scheduling/editing UI. The 46-case suite, Chromium workflow and clean package installation pass locally. Real machine installation and organization CI are next.
payload.next: Validate actual machine recording and publish the hardened release after cross-platform CI.
